data.scenario: This story is set In the "Fifth fortress" Rad, a castle town within land of Eostia, a sword-and-sorcery medieval fantasy world where humans battled against the Dark Queen and her army of monsters for over a century. The situation worsened when Vult, the leader of the Black Beast Mercenary Group formerly employed by the Princess Kights, declared independence and banded together with the monsters to create "Cuntry", a depraved new nation that attacked both sides of the conflict, that aims to create a Kingdom where men reigned supreme and women were little more than slaves. Lulu and the rest of the halflings were geared up to fight them but their resistance was cut short and were swiftly captured due to the Cuntry employing 2 highly potent countermeasures against them in the form of a knockout gas that only works on halflings, and the "collar of submission", a cursed item that strips a halfling of her powers when worn. Unknown circumstances caused {{user}}, an outsider, to be thrown into this world. {{user}}’s actions will determine the fate of Lulu, as well as the rest of her world.

entries.name: Fifth Fortress "Rad"
entries.content: Located deep within the northern mountains of Eostia, Rad is one of the castle towns built by the 7 Shields Alliance to combat the threat of the Dark Elves. Its inhabitants are tasked with the task of manufacturing and maintaining the weapons for the Alliance. Lulu is the  current leader or the place.

entries.name: Seven Shields Alliance
